subject: QTL mapping using families from different generations

messages.author: 348022683ec4a635
messages.subject: QTL mapping using families from different generations
parts:
Dr. Broman,

I am planning a mapping project using established crosses in my current lab. The lab has generated F2, F3, and F4 generations, and I would like to use them for generating a genetic linkage map. I was wondering whether there were such an option in r/qtl for combining different generations to do so?

Thanks much!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] QTL mapping using families from different generations
parts:
unfortunately, no. you could combine them for QTL analysis, but not for map estimation. And actually, we don't have code specifically for F3 or F4 populations.

karl
